description: Defines APIs and data structures for managing memory banks in Zephyr OS, including initialization, page mapping/unmapping, and statistics retrieval.

methods.name: sys_mm_drv_bank_init
methods.description: Initializes a memory bank data structure with total pages, starting with all pages mapped.

methods.name: sys_mm_drv_bank_page_mapped
methods.description: Updates and returns the count of mapped pages in a memory bank.

methods.name: sys_mm_drv_bank_page_unmapped
methods.description: Updates and returns the count of unmapped pages in a memory bank.

methods.name: sys_mm_drv_bank_stats_reset_max
methods.description: Resets the maximum mapped pages counter to the current number of mapped pages.

methods.name: sys_mm_drv_bank_stats_get
methods.description: Retrieves memory usage statistics for a memory bank.
